description: c115 save-wire-format-pillar coverage: proves the PC-native save subsystem initializes cleanly at boot with a canonical v2 agent JSON fixture pre-staged in the save directory. Honest scope: at vanilla --no-net --skip-intro boot, saveInit() (port/src/savefile.c:269) fires deterministically and emits 'SAVE: initialized — save dir: <path>' + saveMigrateInit() fires before it and emits 'SAVEMIGRATE: Initialized (0 migrations registered, current save version: 2)'. saveLoadAgent / saveListAgents are NOT called automatically at boot -- both require user-driven Agent Select menu nav (port/fast3d/pdgui_menu_agentselect.cpp:116). Therefore this test does NOT assert 'SAVE: agent <name> loaded' (would fail without scripted nav); it instead asserts (1) the save subsystem inits in the correct save-dir under --portable, (2) the canonical v2 agent fixture (tools/smoke-verify/fixtures/agent_smoke.json) lands at <install>/agent_smoke.json via the run.ps1::Copy-SmokeFixtures path, and (3) NO loader-side error fires touching the fixture path. --portable forces fsInit() to set saveDir = exeDir (install dir) instead of the AppData/Roaming/perfectdark default, so the fixture is discoverable. If a future build wires saveLoadAgent into the boot path (or if menu-nav infrastructure stabilises enough to drive Agent Select), this test grows to assert 'SAVE: agent smoke loaded from ...' as an additional required line. Sister test for the save-wire-format pillar.

input_sequence.comment: boot path: vanilla --no-net --portable boot, no scripted nav. fsInit() runs saveDir=exeDir (install dir) because of --portable. saveMigrateInit() then saveInit() fire during main.c init (lines 956-957) before any menu code runs. The fixture agent_smoke.json sits at <install>/agent_smoke.json; saveLoadAgent is not auto-called at boot so the fixture's presence is verified only via absence of loader errors touching it.

scripted exit at 15s -- saveInit + saveMigrateInit complete by ~1s on a clean install (per the shared-install reference run). 14s headroom covers cold-start variance and asset catalog warm-up. smokeHarnessExit fires SMOKE: result=scripted_exit on exit.

required_lines: SAVEMIGRATE: Initialized \(0 migrations registered, current save version: 2\)
